claims.name: tickets-github
claims.risk: the export reader misreads what the host wrote

claims.name: tickets-brief
claims.risk: a brief misstates the ticket, a section it names or a check

claims.name: tickets-check
claims.risk: check misreports what the tickets say

claims.name: tickets-claims
claims.risk: a claims plan is read as something it does not say, or stops a verb where it should be refused

claims.name: tickets-skills
claims.risk: the skills tell an agent something false or unsafe about the ticket layer

claims.name: tickets-docs
claims.risk: the user documents say something false about the ticket layer

claims.name: tickets-declaration
claims.risk: the store declaration reads a project's word as something it did not say

claims.name: tickets-model
claims.risk: the normalised ticket and its schema come apart

claims.name: tickets-report
claims.risk: a report key or message code exists that no contract and no schema declares

claims.name: schemas-subset
claims.risk: a shipped schema uses a keyword the engine's checker ignores

claims.name: gate-stdlib
claims.risk: a third-party import enters the engine

claims.name: floor-fast
claims.risk: the floor finds a new finding, a missing tool or an unruled loosening

claims.name: validation-redaction
claims.risk: a redacting claim's report detail carries a parser's raw note

claims.name: discovery-adapters
claims.risk: a discovery or harness-table refusal names less than the whole set a caller has to fix

claims.name: adoption-writers
claims.risk: the two adoption writers, or the two managed-block readers, come apart

claims.name: decision-brief
claims.risk: a decision brief is drawn in a shape a terminal or a markdown view misreads, or padded past what is known

claims.name: adopt
claims.risk: an install writes, records, checks or removes a block, file, fact or skill other than the install design says, or a verb's help names a command that does not run

claims.name: floor
claims.risk: the floor misreads a tool's findings, fits a project wrongly, or lets a loosening pass

claims.name: shipped-commands
claims.risk: a command the shipped text or a --help usage line gives an agent does not run in an adopting project

claims.name: instructions-audit
claims.risk: the instruction audit misses or misreports what a harness loads

claims.name: fragments
claims.risk: a fragment is parsed, detected or rendered wrongly

claims.name: script-help
claims.risk: an entry point reads --help as an argument and fails, or answers it having checked nothing

claims.name: ci-workflow
claims.risk: the release check or this repository's CI workflow stops agreeing with VERSION, the changelog or the tag

claims.name: claude-pointer
claims.risk: a route writes or asks for a CLAUDE.md pointer where Claude Code reads AGENTS.md itself, or stops writing one where it does not

claims.name: suite
claims.risk: a change breaks behaviour a test in this repository holds, a wording pin or a contract test among them

claims.name: evals-runner
claims.risk: the eval runner runs a model other than the one named, hands the model another kernel than its arm's, lets an API key reach codex, or counts a run whose grader the model rewrote

claims.name: eval-scenarios
claims.risk: a scenario's post-check accepts the behaviour it exists to catch, or rejects the one it exists to pass

claims.name: spec-shapes
claims.risk: a rewritten spec template scaffolds a spec the checker misreads
